name: ServerListIndicators
description: Add online friend count or server count in the server list
summary: How many friends are online and how many servers you are in, above the server list

choices.label: Both server and online friend counts

settings.label: Use compact
settings.description: Makes the indicator appear with only text

notes: Above the server list, a count of your friends who are online (idle and do not disturb count; offline and invisible don't), the number of servers you are in (in folders or not), or both, each with upstream's icon, or as text ("3 Friends") with "Use compact"; the tooltip reads "3 Friends, 12 Servers". The counts follow presences, servers and friends as they change, and settings apply at once, without upstream's restart.
gaps: Servers you asked to join that haven't let you in yet aren't counted; upstream counts pending join requests.
